title: BNPL Gold: How to Apply and Get Started
summary: This document explains how to apply for BNPL Gold from your account, including what you need (business/ownership details, requested verification documents, and a primary email and mobile number). It also covers approval/startup usage (accepting the agreement), the starting credit-limit range, and first-plan terms (standard repayment term, introductory promotional APR and duration, then standard APR for remaining balances).
